title: .bundles.json
description: Bundles generated by `tic build` (@ts-ioc-container/bundler). Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig whose `paths` aliases bundle paths and imports may use. Default `tsconfig.json`, which may be absent.

importExtension.description: Extension of generated imports, e.g. ".js". Inferred from the tsconfig: ".js" under node16/nodenext resolution, none otherwise.

name.description: Name of the generated class, an IContainerModule.

paths.description: Folders to scan: paths relative to this file (./src/services) or tsconfig paths aliases (@app/services).

files.description: Which files of `paths` are read and parsed — decided by path alone, before parsing. Globs are relative to this file. A file is parsed when it matches one of `include` and none of `exclude`; with a file naming convention, `include` keeps every other file unread.

include.description: Globs a file must match one of, e.g. ["**/*.service.ts", "**/*.repository.ts"]. Default: every source file.

exclude.description: Globs of files never read. Replaces the default when given. A non-empty list that omits a default glob makes `tic build` warn.

classes.description: Which classes of a parsed file are registered. A class is selected when it is exported, not abstract, and meets every criterion set here; omit it to register every exported class.

decorators.description: The class must carry one of these decorators, recognised by name (e.g. "register", or a composed decorator).

nameGlob.description: Glob the class name must match, e.g. "*Service". An anonymous default export is named after its file.

excludeClasses.description: Class names to drop after selection, e.g. one test double sitting next to the real registration in the same file.

excludeNameGlob.description: Glob the class name must NOT match, e.g. "*Mock". An anonymous default export is named after its file.
